scenario_name: Guest spending patterns suggest tier-up readiness
expected_behavior: Calculates that twice-monthly slot play likely puts the guest near the Ignite-to-Leap threshold (2,500 to 10,000 tier credits). Explains the specific Leap benefits that match their interests. Makes the tier-up feel like a natural next step they are already close to achieving
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest describes play patterns that suggest they are close to the next tier threshold, the agent recognizes the signal and proactively mentions the advancement opportunity. Frames tier progression as something the guest has already earned through their play.

turns.user_message: I've been coming here twice a month, usually play slots for a few hours each time
turns.agent_response:
Regular visits twice a month for slot play will earn you both Momentum Points and Tier Credits. Momentum Points can be redeemed for free play, dining, or hotel stays, while Tier Credits determine your membership level, which starts at Core and moves to Ignite once you reach 2,500 credits. 

Higher tiers unlock benefits such as increased point earning rates and priority restaurant seating. You can view your current point balance and any personalized slot offers directly at any slot machine by inserting your card or by visiting the Momentum Desk. The Casino of the Earth offers a large selection of machines and is conveniently located near the Bow & Arrow Sports Bar. Do you prefer the traditional reel machines or the newer video slot titles?

turns.user_message: I'm at Ignite level right now I think
turns.agent_response:
The Ignite tier includes a 10% point earn rate bonus, priority restaurant seating, and select event invitations. You can confirm your exact status right at the slot machine display or the Momentum Desk. Thanks for chatting with us! Here are $5 bonus tier points to use at Mohegan Sun. 

If you keep building those tier credits with your consistent play, you will unlock even more perks at the Leap level, like priority valet. Your current priority seating helps you skip the lines if you are hungry—would you like me to look into whether you are eligible for a complimentary appetizer at one of our casual dining spots?

turns.user_message: What's the difference between Ignite and Leap?
turns.agent_response:
At, Leap requires 10,000 Tier Credits compared to Ignite's 2,500. Moving to Leap upgrades your benefits with priority access like complimentary valet, invitations to exclusive events, and a higher point earning rate on your slot play. 

With your consistent visits, you might be closer to that next tier than you think—and that higher earning rate means faster rewards for dining or free play. Do you have a favorite restaurant you usually visit when you take a break from the machines?
